assumptions_not_claimed_as_rtl_calibrati: Cache T/W-stage sequencing, PLRU/bimodal insertion probability, and exact pipeline stage latencies are structural timing models pending cycle-by-cycle trace calibration.

The default DDR endpoint models FROST's single-channel axi_behavioral_memory.sv (LATENCY=30, NUM_SLOTS=max(L2MaxSlots,8)); board DDR4 MIG refresh and bank/row timing require hardware or VIP trace calibration.
Workload micro-ops are representative pressure patterns, not captured Redis, HTTP, Linux or FaaS execution traces.
The model does not execute the RISC-V ISA, model Sv39 page walks/DMA coherence traffic as workload events, or prove functional RTL equivalence.
The candidate sweep may rank sensitivities, but synthesis/Fmax/area and RTL waveform comparison are required before an RTL change is accepted.
implemented_features: Explicit CpuTopModel + SocTopModel separation across the 6-bit-ID, 512-bit AXI4 boundary so downstream projects can replace SocTopModel or DdrController independently.
Two-wide dispatch/retire, bounded ROB/RS/LQ/SQ, out-of-order load/ALU completion, two-lane CDB contention, conservative non-speculative stores at commit.
Load Queue L0 Data Cache (256 dword entries) with 1-cycle CDB fast-path bypass and fill from L1D memory responses.
Separate L1I and L1D caches; 32-byte to 64-byte sector adapter; L2 with stream prefetcher; fill ownership; coalescing; writeback slots; write intent; cache-line dirty state.

Explicit cache lower transaction IDs ({type, slot}), 64-byte single-beat AXI transfers, soc_axi_slave physical address decode (DDR vs. local BRAM/MMIO), and a single-channel 512-bit AXI DDR model matching axi_behavioral_memory.sv.
Deterministic workload generators, sweep driver, self-tests, and machine-readable bottleneck counters.

source_proven_facts.fact: Platform composition splits cpu_top and soc_top across a single 6-bit-ID, 512-bit (64B) AXI4 master/slave boundary.
Two-wide dispatch and commit; 32-entry ROB; 8-entry load and store queues; explicit RS capacities (16 INT RS, 8 MEM RS); 4-bundle decoded queue.
Production cache parameters in cpu_top are L1I 16 KiB, L1D 128 KiB, L2 2 MiB, four ways, L1D MSHR 8, L2 MSHR 4, L2 WB 2, L2 waiters 2, prefetch enabled.
L1 lines are 32 bytes; L2 and DDR-facing AXI lines are 64 bytes/512 bits; AXI transactions are single beat.
Cache MSHRs reserve their victim way until fill and downstream IDs encode {type,slot}; L1D uses four-bit IDs and L2 uses five-bit IDs (DdrAxiIdBits=5).
A line-size adapter maps 32-byte L1 sectors into 64-byte L2 lines; L2 supports bounded MSHR waiters and stream prefetching.

soc_axi_slave routes physical DDR addresses [0x8000_0000, +DdrCapacityBytes) to a single 5-bit-ID, 512-bit DDR AXI port (backed in simulation by axi_behavioral_memory with latency=30, NUM_SLOTS=max(L2MaxSlots,8), optional LFSR jitter and reorder) and routes low BRAM/MMIO to a single local port.
Load Queue direct-mapped L0 Data Cache (NormalLqL0Depth = 256 dword entries) provides 1-cycle fast-path bypass for cached hits; EARLY_LOAD_WAKEUP enables 1-cycle dependent scheduling.
